# flowdown

> flowdown is a Markdown renderer for React and AI replies: GitHub Markdown plus a dialect of steps, tabs, figures, callouts, sources, diagrams and math, drawn while the text streams.

One package with its own parser and no dependencies. `<Markdown streaming>` draws a reply as it
arrives and repairs unfinished syntax; `@localix/flowdown/static`, `@localix/flowdown/dom`, `@localix/flowdown/element` and
`@localix/flowdown/tui` draw the same reply as HTML text, in a page with no framework, as a custom element
and in a terminal. `answerFormatPrompt()` from `@localix/flowdown/prompt` is the text that teaches a model
the dialect.

Install: `npm install @localix/flowdown`. Source: https://github.com/rsaryev/flowdown
